domestic_evidence: HFCL investor page (https://www.hfcl.com/investors) financial highlights FY26: "₹ 5,014.52 Total income (in crore)", "₹ 826.75 EBITDA (in crore)", "16.70 % EBITDA margin", "₹ 329.44 Profit after tax (in crore)". Company is NSE-listed ("NSE: HFCL 164.27 INR") and its solutions pages list BharatNet rural broadband and Railway Communications public-sector programmes, i.e. domestic Indian telecom/railway supply. Note: the annual report does not split domestic vs export revenue in the free-viewed page; GSTIN-level turnover band and GeM/CPPP contract rows were not retrieved (search tool returned no results), so the domestic figure is the consolidated total income, not a domestic-only number.
note: Legal entity HFCL LIMITED (8, Electronics Complex, Chambaghat, Solan, HP) is active and listed; no liquidation/bankruptcy indication. Declared HS 852910 (antennas/parts) does not match the observed export records, which are all HS 90011000 (optical fibres/fibre bundles) — HS should be corrected to 90011000 for the observed trade; per project rules this is not a rejection ground. Role: manufacturer (own plants, own product lines) — not a trader. Export shipments are factual, dated, with destination and B/L numbers. Domestic supply is factual at company level (₹5,014.52 cr FY26 total income, listed, BharatNet/railway programmes) but no GST-band or tender-level row was captured. Revenue: ₹5,014.52 crore total income FY26 (consolidated, domestic+export not split in free view). Export volume in physical/currency terms: null (not public in free view).
